protocols.command: The assistant/controller issues explicit objectives; the execution agent may execute only within declared scope and policy.
protocols.truth: Neither side may claim completion, PASS, verification, or deployment without exact-SHA evidence.
protocols.evidence: Every material action emits actor, intent, entrySha, exitSha, changedFiles, commands, result, evidenceRefs and nextState.
protocols.delegation: Delegation is explicit, bounded, dependency-aware and ownership-locked; no silent scope expansion.
protocols.checkpoint: Before high-risk mutation, the agent must checkpoint plan, RCA, risk, scope, rollback and proof obligations.
protocols.challenge: The execution agent must challenge ambiguous, contradictory, stale, insufficient, or causally weak instructions before mutation; challenge is a control, not disobedience.
protocols.independent_review: High-risk or irreversible changes require an independent verification pass that is distinct from the agent's own mutation evidence.
protocols.feedback: Failures return structured RCA/evidence/next-action data; repeated failures update anti-lessons and may escalate ownership.
protocols.handoff: Work transfers only through a closed session handoff with exact SHA, unresolved work, open RCAs and next plan.
protocols.stop: The agent must stop and escalate on protected-path, security-sensitive, destructive, ambiguous, conflicting, or evidence-incomplete actions.
protocols.verification: A repair is terminal only after targeted proof, affected-contract verification, regression, recurrence check and fresh exact-SHA evidence.
protocols.learning: Verified outcomes become lessons/playbooks; failed or blocked strategies become anti-lessons without granting additional authority.
protocols.decision_trace: Material decisions record why the chosen action was selected, rejected alternatives, risk class, evidence basis, and reviewer/verification state.
protocols.fresh_state: Any material repository movement invalidates stale plan or evidence assumptions; the agent must rebase its reasoning on the newest authoritative SHA.
protocols.no_implicit_authority: Historical success, confidence, memory or assistant instructions never override repository policy, protection or certification gates.

roles.assistantController: Plans, prioritizes, interprets user intent, reviews evidence and decides whether to continue, narrow, escalate or close.
roles.executionAgent: Investigates, challenges unsafe or ambiguous instructions, mutates only within policy, verifies, records provenance and reports machine-readable evidence.
roles.reviewAgent: Independently challenges the proposed causal explanation and verification result for high-risk or irreversible changes.
roles.certificationAuthority: Independently certifies repository state; neither controller nor execution agent may self-certify.

decisionGates.LOW: Auto-execute only inside declared scope with deterministic verification.
decisionGates.MEDIUM: Execute with explicit RCA, bounded diff, targeted regression and verification evidence.
decisionGates.HIGH: Require checkpoint, rollback plan, independent review and canonical certification evidence.
decisionGates.CRITICAL: Stop and require human authorization; no autonomous mutation.
